Hi Thomas,

To answer you straight: the two Thor P2s have not shipped yet. I checked this morning and there's no shipment or tracking for them on our side, and the $63.98 refund hasn't gone through yet either. I'm sorry. After everything you've been through on this order, you shouldn't have to keep asking.

I've passed your acceptance and your address ((address hidden), (address hidden)) to the team to get the replacement out. A colleague will pick it up when the team is back and confirm it with you by email.

When the Thor P2s ship, you'll get the tracking number by email. That way you can follow the delivery date and make sure someone is home to sign for it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
